title: Section of a sign-valued function
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the binary cube, and choose a linear coordinate decomposition of the cube into $H$ and a complementary binary cube. For a sign-valued function $f$ on the full cube and a point $a$ in the complementary cube, its section at $a$ is the value of $f$ at the point with zero $H$-coordinate and complementary coordinate $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary subspace split of the cube
A sign-valued function on the cube
A point in the complementary cube
